set -eu
check_site() {
  host=$1
  path=$2
  source=$3
  out=$(mktemp)
  code=$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 5 -H "Host: $host" -o "$out" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080$path")
  printf '%s %s STATUS=%s MATCH=' "$host" "$path" "$code"
  if cmp -s "$out" "$source"; then printf 'yes\n'; else printf 'no\n'; fi
  rm -f "$out"
}
check_site docs.branch.test / /srv/legacy2/name-based-web-tenants/docs/index.html
check_site docs.branch.test /handbook.txt /srv/legacy2/name-based-web-tenants/docs/handbook.txt
check_site orders.branch.test / /srv/legacy2/name-based-web-tenants/orders/index.html
check_site orders.branch.test /catalog.csv /srv/legacy2/name-based-web-tenants/orders/catalog.csv
unknown=$(mktemp)
unknown_code=$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 5 -H 'Host: unknown.branch.test' -o "$unknown" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/")
printf 'unknown.branch.test / STATUS=%s DOCS_LEAK=' "$unknown_code"
if cmp -s "$unknown" /srv/legacy2/name-based-web-tenants/docs/index.html; then printf 'yes'; else printf 'no'; fi
printf ' ORDERS_LEAK='
if cmp -s "$unknown" /srv/legacy2/name-based-web-tenants/orders/index.html; then printf 'yes\n'; else printf 'no\n'; fi
printf 'UNKNOWN_BODY='; tr '\n' ' ' < "$unknown" | head -c 160; printf '\n'
rm -f "$unknown"
